s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly growing caruncular lesion with ulceration
salient_findings: Amelanotic, pedunculated mass with ulcerated surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
key_facts: Male patient in his late 60s
4-week history of a rapidly growing left caruncular lesion
Medical and ocular histories were unremarkable
Ocular examination findings were normal except for the caruncular lesion
No evidence of PAM (primary acquired melanosis)
Specimen measured 8 × 6 × 5 mm with a 4-mm ulceration
Necrotic tissue on the surface of the specimen
Solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface
Positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
Significant number of cycling cells shown by Ki-67 proliferation marker
Sentinel lymph node biopsy findings were negative
Conjunctival and orbital biopsies revealed no tumor

raw.syndrome_frame: Rapidly growing caruncular lesion with ulceration
salient_findings: Amelanotic, pedunculated mass with ulcerated surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
key_facts: Male patient in his late 60s
4-week history of a rapidly growing left caruncular lesion
Medical and ocular histories were unremarkable
Ocular examination findings were normal except for the caruncular lesion
No evidence of PAM (primary acquired melanosis)
Specimen measured 8 × 6 × 5 mm with a 4-mm ulceration
Necrotic tissue on the surface of the specimen
Solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface
Positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
Significant number of cycling cells shown by Ki-67 proliferation marker
Sentinel lymph node biopsy findings were negative
Conjunctival and orbital biopsies revealed no tumor

raw.rationale: The presence of a rapidly growing, ulcerated, and pedunculated mass with positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A, along with a high proliferative index shown by Ki-67, strongly supports the diagnosis of malignant melanoma.

rejected.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers or characteristics typical of sebaceous gland carcinoma in the provided histopathology and immunohistochemistry results

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The absence of features typical of squamous cell carcinoma, such as keratinization or the presence of squamous cells, in the histopathological examination

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The clinical and histopathological features do not align with basal cell carcinoma, which typically presents with different morphological characteristics and lacks the melanocytic markers found in this case

rejected.label: Atypical fibroxanthoma
rejected.why: The presence of melanocytic markers and the specific characteristics of the tumor do not support a diagnosis of atypical fibroxanthoma, which is more commonly associated with sun-damaged skin and lacks the distinctive melanocytic features found in this case
